rows.grounds: compound of tārkṣa (Garuḍa) and īśvarī (lady, goddess)
compound of tārkṣa (Garuḍa), īśī (lady), vara (boon), and dāyinī (giver)

items.question: Which Garuda-related identities and boon-granting power characterize this goddess?
premises: The goddess is identified as the lady associated with Garuda.
The goddess is identified as the mother of Garuda.
The goddess is identified as the giver of boons in her Garuda-associated form.
items.inference: This verse attributes to the goddess sovereign, maternal, and boon-granting roles in relation to Garuda.
uncertainties: The internal segmentation of tārkkṣeśīvaradāyinī follows the legacy hint but may admit alternative compound analysis.
items.plain_english: She is the lady of Garuda, the mother of Garuda, and the boon-giving lady of Garuda.
